draft_en.subject: Switches for the automation store - a managed PoE unit and two DIN-rail industrials
draft_en.body:
Hello Automationstore team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 16 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the switch category in your automation store, neutral-brand units at distributor price, EXW, from single units, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD; DIN-rail industrial 5 x Gigabit unmanaged, 12-36 V DC, -40 to 75 C - STI-050GE - $17.0; 8-port, 12-58 V DC - STI-080GE - $32.5.

One question: which switch SKU do your automation customers order most - the DIN-rail 5/8-port, or a PoE unit?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
